question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Hinder
solution:
The correct answer is: **Aid**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Hinder"** means to create difficulties for someone or something, resulting in delay or obstruction. (बाधा डालना)

 
 
• **Example: **The heavy traffic may **hinder **the arrival of emergency vehicles.
 
 
 
• **"Aid" **refers to help or support, typically of a practical nature. (सहायता करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The charity organization provided **aid **to the flood victims.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'hinder' **is **'aid'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Monitor** (निगरानी करना): To observe and check the progress or quality of something over a period of time.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher will **monitor **the students' progress throughout the term.
 
 
 
• **Domesticate** (पालतू बनाना): To tame an animal and keep it as a pet or on a farm.
 
 
• **Example: **Humans have **domesticated **dogs for thousands of years.
 
 
 
• **Force** (बल): Strength or energy as an attribute of physical action or movement.
 
 
• **Example:** The **force **of the wind was enough to topple trees.
